content.text:
The root cause was in `readString` in `lexer/lexer.go`. The `\\` escape case had an extra `i++`, so after handling the escaped backslash it skipped the next character. That swallowed a following character, or the closing quote, so strings like `"x\\"` came back as unterminated. The query parser failures came from the same bug because it uses the lexer.

I removed the stray `i++`. `go test ./...` now passes in every package, and I didn't touch any test files.
